description: (Tag:character)(Tag:fire)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:life)(Tag:magician)(Tag:small-size)(Character)Nashrah, once the Doom and Terror of modern man, is now a floating disembodied immortal head and extremely powerful wizard specializing in Blood Magic, Pyromancy, and rituals. Despite foul, vulgar behavior he has considerable wisdom and knowledge, his loyalty is gacha-enforced, and you get a free reroll of the ticket you rolled him on.
